title: docs: regenerate APIDOCS.md
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt: Auto-generated from OpenAPI spec changes after a successful production deploy.

gist.headline: The API map gets redrawn
gist.blurb: The API reference gets a fresh pass from the OpenAPI spec. Even the map needs updating when the paths change.
gist.summary: Regenerates APIDOCS.md from the OpenAPI spec, replacing 36 lines with 32 to keep the API reference in sync.
gist.impact: Developers get an API reference that reflects the latest generated spec rather than an older snapshot.
gist.visual_concept: Polli, wearing tiny librarian glasses, checks a pixelated API map against a glowing OpenAPI terminal. Small code-plants grow beside the desk; the scene represents a reference being refreshed, not a new endpoint.
